packrat plan  packrat-rails  Rails 7.2.2, Ruby 3.1.6

  SIGNAL      SOURCE                  INSTALLED  STEP
  Exceptions  packrat-rails + Sentry  ✓          none: packrat-rails sends it
      packrat-rails sends Rails.error to Packrat; Sentry keeps its own
  Traces      packrat-rails           ✓          none: packrat-rails sends it
      packrat-rails sends traces to Packrat
  Logs        packrat-rails           ✓          none: packrat-rails sends it
      packrat-rails sends logs to Packrat
  Replays     Sentry browser          ✓          copy to Packrat with a DSN
      replays on

Add --app service/env to detect if Packrat is receiving data from each signal.
